# Josupeit.Practices.Commands.Abstractions

> Interface-only NuGet package defining the CQRS command and query contracts used across Josupeit.Practices: `ICommand`, `ICommand<TInput>`, `ICommandWithOutput<TOutput>`, `ICommandWithOutput<TInput, TOutput>`, `IQuery<TOutput>`, and `IQuery<TInput, TOutput>`. Every interface exposes a synchronous `Execute` and two asynchronous `ExecuteAsync` overloads so callers never need to know whether an implementation is sync or async underneath. Targets netstandard2.0 and net8.0, has no dependencies, and lives in the `Josupeit.Practices.Commands` namespace.

Install with `dotnet add package Josupeit.Practices.Commands.Abstractions`. All types live in the `Josupeit.Practices.Commands` namespace - not `Josupeit.Practices.Commands.Abstractions`. The package contains six interfaces and nothing else:

- `ICommand` - no input, no output
- `ICommand<in TInput>` - one input, no output
- `ICommandWithOutput<TOutput>` - no input, returns `TOutput`
- `ICommandWithOutput<in TInput, TOutput>` - one input, returns `TOutput`
- `IQuery<TOutput>` - no input, returns `TOutput`, must be pure
- `IQuery<in TInput, TOutput>` - one input, returns `TOutput`, must be pure

Each interface has exactly three members: `Execute(...)`, `ExecuteAsync(...)`, and `ExecuteAsync(..., CancellationToken)`; none has a default implementation. By contract, `ExecuteAsync(...)` is equivalent to `ExecuteAsync(..., CancellationToken.None)`. Type parameters are ordered input first, output second. `TInput` is contravariant, `TOutput` is invariant. `IQuery` members carry `[System.Diagnostics.Contracts.Pure]`. There is no multi-input variant; bundle several arguments into a record.

Unlike MediatR-style libraries, a command is the executable object itself - behavior plus injected collaborators - not a message dispatched to a separate handler; there is no `Send()` or `IRequestHandler`. Concrete base classes that implement these interfaces and bridge sync and async automatically ship in the separate `Josupeit.Practices.Commands` package.

Load this to write code against the package.
- [PublicAPI.Shipped.txt](https://codeberg.org/DerPeit/Josupeit.Practices/raw/branch/main/src/Josupeit.Practices.Commands.Abstractions/PublicAPI.Shipped.txt): analyzer-enforced inventory of every public member. `!` marks non-nullable and `?` nullable reference types; `abstract`/`virtual`/`override`/`static` prefixes mark member kind; accessibility is not shown.
- [README](https://codeberg.org/DerPeit/Josupeit.Practices/raw/branch/main/src/Josupeit.Practices.Commands.Abstractions/README.md): human-oriented package overview as shown on NuGet.

## Related packages

- [Josupeit.Practices.Commands](https://codeberg.org/DerPeit/Josupeit.Practices/raw/branch/main/src/Josupeit.Practices.Commands/llms-full.txt): abstract base classes `Command`, `CommandWithOutput`, and `Query` that implement these interfaces, bridge sync and async in both directions, and detect accidental recursion between the two paths.
